mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.order_item_id, a.inventory_id, a.location_id, l.code AS location_code, a.sku_id, p.sku_code, p.name AS sku_name, a.batch_no, a.allocated_qty, a.picked_qty, a.status FROM outbound_allocate a LEFT JOIN location l ON l.id = a.location_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = a.sku_id WHERE a.order_id = #{orderId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id ASC

SELECT id, order_id, order_item_id, inventory_id, warehouse_id, location_id, sku_id, batch_no, allocated_qty, picked_qty, status, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM outbound_allocate WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = #{status} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_allocate SET status = 'RELEASED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'LOCKED' AND deleted = 0
